description: Finds UI copy still hardcoded in the code and translations missing or out of date in the locale files, each with its file and line. Changes nothing and needs no API key. Run it before and after localize or translate.

app.description: Monorepo: the app to work in (e.g. apps/web), relative to the repository root. Default: the root.

changed.description: Only the files changed since the last commit (staged or not, and new ones), like paths.

dir.description: Source folder to scan, relative to the app (default: localize.config.json, else the framework's own).

only.description: Check only hardcoded copy, or only translations.

paths.description: Only these files, relative to the source folder (e.g. ["components/Cart.tsx"]): hardcoded copy and unknown keys in them. Fast; use it on the files you just changed.

name: check
title: Check localization
